Definition: from the inseparable negative particle νή‐ (not) and G2068; not eating, i.e. abstinent from food (religiously):--fasting.
BiblicalUsage: Fasting people are hungry people, and Jesus will not send them home that way. The crowds have been with Him three days with nothing to eat, and He says He will not send them away fasting, lest they faint on the road — some of them came from far.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the compassion comes first: Jesus sees the hunger before He teaches the lesson.
